title: Robust Instruction Compliance in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2605.12655v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) in real-world use cases may need to adapt to external natural language instructions that interrupt ongoing behavior and conflict with long-horizon objectives. However, conditioning rewards on instructions introduces a fundamental failure mode as Bellman updates couple value estimates across instruction contexts, leading to inconsistent values when instructions interrupt macro-actions. We propose Macro-Action Value Correction for Instruction Compliance (MAVIC), which corrects Bellman backups at instruction boundaries by correcting the incoming instruction objective and restoring the continuation value under the current objective. Unlike reward shaping, MAVIC modifies the bootstrapping target itself, enabling consistent value estimation under stochastic instruction switching within a unified policy. translated_title: 协作式多智能体强化学习中的鲁棒指令遵循
translated_abstract: 在现实世界的应用场景中，多智能体强化学习（MARL）可能需要适应外部自然语言指令，这些指令会中断正在执行的行为，并与长期目标发生冲突。然而，将奖励条件化于指令之上会引入一种根本性的失效模式：贝尔曼更新将不同指令上下文中的价值估计耦合在一起，当指令中断宏动作时会导致价值估计不一致。我们提出了用于指令遵循的宏动作价值校正方法（MAVIC），该方法在指令边界处修正贝尔曼备份：通过校正新到来的指令目标，并恢复当前目标下的延续价值。与奖励塑形不同，MAVIC 直接修改自举目标本身，使得在统一策略下进行随机指令切换时仍能获得一致的价值估计。我们提供了理论分析和演员-评论家（actor-critic）实现，并证明 MAVIC 能够实现……
tldr: 提出MAVIC方法，通过在指令边界处修正贝尔曼备份（校正新到来的指令目标并恢复当前目标下的延续价值），解决了多智能体强化学习中指令中断宏动作导致的价值估计不一致问题，从而在统一策略下实现对随机自然语言指令的鲁棒遵循。
en_tdlr: MAVIC corrects Bellman backups at instruction boundaries by fixing the incoming instruction objective and restoring the continuation value under the current objective, enabling consistent value estimation and robust natural language instruction compliance in multi-agent reinforcement learning despite stochastic instruction interruptions of macro-actions.
